question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mo>:</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ℝ</mi><mo>→</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ℝ</mi></math> be a function defined as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>sin</mi><mfenced><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>x</mi></mfenced></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ℝ</mi></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open="["><mi>t</mi></mfenced></math> is the greatest integer less than or equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi></math>. Then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><munder><mi>lim</mi><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></munder><mi>g</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>h</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced></math> is

Given below are two statements :
Statement I : $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0}\left(\frac{\tan ^{-1} x+\log _e \sqrt{\frac{1+x}{1-x}}-2 x}{x^5}\right)=\frac{2}{5}$
Statement II : $\lim _{\mathrm{x} \rightarrow 1}\left(\mathrm{x}^{\frac{2}{1-\mathrm{x}}}\right)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^2}$
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.text: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
